source_clause: HVACP7.) When an HVAC popup is displayed over another popup, if user touches a selectable item inside the bottom pop-up (e.g. OK or X ) then the action is taken and HVAC pop-up is closed.
reasoning: 驗證目標：14.7（HVACP7）定出觸碰下層 popup 之可選項時執行其動作且關閉 HVAC popup，兩個 leaf 分別對應「動作被執行」與「HVAC popup 關閉」。關鍵情境條件：同 14.1.1。為什麼這樣切：兩者可獨立失效（動作執行了而 popup 未關、或 popup 關了而動作未執行）。刻意略過：同 14.6，不指名下層 popup。

tcs.tc_title: Touching a selectable item of the lower pop-up takes its action
tcs.test_item:
HVACP7.) When an HVAC popup is displayed over another popup, if user touches a selectable item inside the bottom pop-up (e.g. OK or X ) then the action is taken and HVAC pop-up is closed.

(touch the selectable item of the bottom pop-up -> The action of the bottom pop-up is taken)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The head unit is on and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a pop-up that has a selectable item, then change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
2. Touch the selectable item of the bottom pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan pop-up is shown over the other pop-up
2. The action of the bottom pop-up is taken
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
